_comment: Master settings file for the event website. Edit anything here or use the Admin → Settings page. The names, emails, and venue below are fictional sample data.

site.title: Alex Sample's Bar Mitzvah
site.rsvpClosedMessage: The RSVP period has now closed. Please contact Jordan or Taylor directly if you have questions.
site.footerTagline: Made with love for Alex · Sample Family · 2026

events.name: Shabbat Services & Dinner
events.description: Kabbalat Shabbat services followed by a festive Shabbat dinner. For family and out-of-town guests.

events.name: Bar Mitzvah Service & Luncheon
events.description: Alex will chant from the Torah and deliver his d'var Torah, followed by a festive celebratory luncheon.
events.additionalNotes: All guests are welcome to attend the service.

events.name: Evening Celebration
events.description: An outdoor evening under the stars — cocktails, dinner, dancing, and celebration beneath the gazebo.
events.dressCode: Cocktail attire. Comfortable footwear recommended for the lawn.
events.additionalNotes: A light layer is recommended for the evening air.

events.name: Morning After Breakfast
events.description: A relaxed morning breakfast to close out the weekend with family and close friends.

travel.parkingInfo: Free parking is available on-site at the venue.
travel.dressCodEvening: Cocktail attire. Comfortable footwear recommended for the lawn.

about.honoreeBlurb:
Alex is a curious, creative young person who loves music, books, and time with friends and family.

This section is sample text. Replace it in Admin → Settings with a few paragraphs about your honoree.

reminders.label: First Reminder
reminders.description: Friendly first reminder — 2 weeks before RSVP deadline

preEventUpdates.label: Pre-Event Logistics Email
preEventUpdates.description: Sends 5 days before the event — venue details, parking, dress code reminder

preEventUpdates.label: Day-Before Reminder
preEventUpdates.description: Optional reminder the day before — enable if you want a final heads-up sent to guests

testRun._comment: Send test invitations to specific email addresses — one per event combination — before sending to real guests.

testCases.label: Custom Combination
testCases.description: Define your own set of events

saveTheDate.subject: Save the Date — Alex's Bar Mitzvah · August 22, 2026

saveTheDate.closingLine: Formal invitations with full details will follow soon. We can't wait to celebrate with you!

invitation.openingLine: We are so pleased to invite you to celebrate with us as our son Alex becomes a Bar Mitzvah.
invitation.closingLine: We hope you'll be able to join us for this very special day. Please RSVP using your personal link below.

reminder.subject: Friendly reminder — Please RSVP for Alex's Bar Mitzvah
reminder.previewText: We'd love to know if you can join us
reminder.openingLine: We just wanted to send a friendly reminder that the RSVP deadline for Alex's Bar Mitzvah is coming up.
reminder.closingLine: If you've already responded, thank you! If not, we'd love to hear from you.
